visual_events.description: In a stable low-angle medium shot looking along a low L-shaped brick wall built on sandy ground, the mason (ent_mason) stands bent over the wall. From 0.0s to 1.8s, he lifts a brick off the top mortar bed of the wall with his left hand while reaching down with his right hand to pick up a vertical brick standing on the ground beside the wall, placing the removed brick down on the ground at 1.4s–1.8s. From 1.8s to 3.4s, he brings the newly selected brick up with both hands and sets it on edge as a cross-brick (header/shiner bridging the two leaves) onto the wet mortar bed at 2.3s–2.6s, while gesturing and pointing with his right index finger toward the adjacent open rectangular cavity inside the wall from 2.2s to 5.6s. From 5.6s to 6.72s, he brings his right hand back up to the placed brick to adjust and steady it with both hands. Meanwhile, on the left, a helper (ent_helper) bends over holding an empty round metal pan above a second pan full of mortar from 0.0s to 5.2s, then stands upright and lifts the empty pan away toward the upper left from 5.2s to 6.72s. In the background, two observers remain mostly stationary.
visual_events.context_result: A brick is placed on edge bridging the wall course, leaving a clearly visible series of hollow rectangular cavities and staggered vertical joints along the wall in the foreground and middle ground; the mason's final adjustment of the brick is still in progress when the clip ends at 6.72s.
